notes.title: 2.0.32 Update
notes.content:
- Added renaming function, allowing trainers to change nicknames.

● Optimizations
- Siege can be shared to world chat and allows trainers to invite non-members of the league to join.
- Added location function to prompt message of Cheeky.
- For trainers not in the league, the prompt message of Cheeky will be sent via private chat.
- Inactive accounts in primary battlefield will be cleared automatically.

- Minor bugs fixed.

tags.feature: - Added renaming function, allowing trainers to change nicknames.
